Valk stands for surprisingly natural, attentive care, long-term loyalty, and customer-oriented quality. These core values form the basis of everything we do. With us, you work in an open, spontaneous atmosphere with room for personal growth. Guests and colleagues feel at home because happy colleagues lead to happy guests...
